name: Courtship
overview: Scripture presents courtship as a purposeful and honorable process rooted in commitment and respect. Genesis 2:24 emphasizes the unity of man and wife as they leave their families to become one flesh, highlighting the seriousness of the marital bond. The examples of Samson speaking with the woman he pleased (Judges 14:7) and Ruth boldly approaching her kinsman-redeemer (Ruth 3:9) reveal that courtship involved intentional interaction, sometimes initiated by the woman, within the framework of ancient customs. Proverbs encourages trust in the Lord throughout this process (Proverbs 3:5), and finding a wife is portrayed as a blessing and favor from God (Proverbs 18:22), underscoring the spiritual significance of courtship and marriage.
